findings.new: en timer til professorterninger
findings.reason: 丹麦语 terning 可以表示骰子或立方体，未明确魔方。可采用词典中的 professorterning 明确对象；属于术语清晰度建议，完整表达可再由母语者确认。
findings.reasonOriginal: The bare word terning can mean a die or cube and this compound does not clearly identify the twisty puzzle being timed. Den Danske Ordbog records professorterning as the puzzle name. This is a terminology-clarity suggestion, not a definite spelling error; a Danish native speaker may confirm the full phrase before changing it.
